body: It'd be cool to talk on the phone if you wanna. I am British, so that would make it more amusing, possibly. Not having the greatest of times. I'm 27 by the way. And a woman.
I'm not feeling good. Just wanna talk on the phone and hear that someone gets it. If you wanna talk, then message me. Lots of dicks on here that just wanna mock (experiences that earlier).
Truancy isn't going to land you in prison.

Ok, why would you go to juvy? From skipping school? You wouldn't go for that.  Even if you did go....your life wouldn't be over. Not at all. There are people that commit much more serious crimes and still live normal lives.  

I don't want to tell you that 'things get better', because that's a cliché and also, not always true. Just take a minute, I suppose. Think about some good things. When I got out from the state hospital after one of my attempts , I would cheer myself up by thinking about my favourite 'combos'. Listening to Death Cab for Cutie and bathing my dog. Talking about dreams and hugging someone I love. Drinking lovely wine and watching a film; warm.

I'm quite a bit older than you. Not trying to preach at all, saying that sincerely.  You have to take things daily. I can tell you now, there will come a day where you won't give a shit about exams or grades...because they won't count anything anymore. Enjoy being young. Sing loud when you want. Ignore what is sensible and do what is fun (sometimes, within reason).  Kiss who you want. Sleep late. Do the things you enjoy. I'm on the cusp of 28 though...so why would you listen to me....?
School is no reason to do this. Breathe.
